reviewer: Codex assistant reference and everyday-sense editorial review
scope: All 589 distinct required spellings and accepted forms reviewed against individual everyday approvals and selected meanings. All 240 boards have five answers, 3-6 letters, global minimum repeat gap 75, unique wheels and answer sets, exact 48 journey stops, existing physical layout gates and challenge/recovery pacing. 95 new target approvals and 24 held candidates have individual decisions; 79 new dictionary entries retain source provenance. Six reviewed barbarisms and the owner-excluded ruli homograph are excluded from all gameplay roles. Valid rare words remain optional bonuses. Historical packs remain immutable. This is assistant editorial review, not native-speaker review or device playtesting. See docs/VOCABULARY_REVIEW_V13.md.
